title: Motifs et théorie de Hodge : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is only a section header for the following page(s). It reads roughly: 'Topological base fields: ≅ R or C (Hodge and de Rham functors in this case)'.

Grothendieck is setting up the realization functors for motives over a base field K equipped with a topology making it isomorphic to R or C. The next page develops this as follows.
- If K ≅ C as a topological field, there are two such isomorphisms (identity and complex conjugation), and he deliberately does not choose one.
- K contains R canonically.
- For smooth projective X over K, the space X(K) is a compact K-analytic manifold. This gives a Betti realization Betti(M) with Q coefficients, defined intrinsically, without fixing K = C.
- The comparison isomorphism Betti(M)⊗K ≅ DR(M) is a ⊗-isomorphism. It puts a real structure on DR(M).
- The resulting complex conjugation σ, together with the Hodge filtration, splits the filtration uniquely into a Hodge bigrading.

So the problem served is defining the Hodge and de Rham realizations, and their comparison, on a category of motives over an archimedean base field. For K ≅ R one expects real Hodge structures with an involution (Deligne's F_∞). The page itself contains no argument.

ideas.what: Realization functors (Betti/Hodge and de Rham) on motives over a topological base field isomorphic to R or C, defined intrinsically without choosing an isomorphism K ≅ C
ideas.modern_name: Hodge realization / de Rham realization of motives over archimedean fields; Betti–de Rham comparison
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (motives programme, 1960s); formalized by Saavedra Rivano, Deligne (Hodge II/III, 1971–74), Deligne–Milne (LNM 900, 1982), Jannsen
ideas.where_published: Ideas transmitted via Demazure, Kleiman ('Motives', 1972) and Saavedra's thesis; no text by Grothendieck himself on this

deep.surprise_reason: This is a bare section heading announcing the standard Hodge and de Rham realizations over R or C. It contains no mathematical content beyond a well-known programme item.
transcription_corrections: 'Corps de bon type' should likely read 'Corps de base top[ologiques]' (cf. the next page heading 'Corps de base topologiques').
'≃ R ou C' may be written '≃ R ~ C' (a dash or tilde) rather than 'ou'.
The struck-out word before 'de Rham' appears to be an overwritten 'DR'/'De' corrected to 'de Rham'.
